title: SPRI Purification Beads Protocol
author: Tomasz Suchan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q3qdymw

steps.title: Prepare 2.5 M NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2.5 M NaCl solution in a 50 ml Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Place a 50 ml Falcon tube on the scale and tare.
Add 14.61 g of NaCl to the tube.
Add water to 40 ml and dissolve the NaCl.
Fill the tube with water to 50 ml and mix.

steps.title: Prepare 50% PEG-8000 solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50% PEG-8000 solution in a 50 ml Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Place a 50 ml Falcon tube on the scale and tare.
Add 12.5 g of PEG-8000 to the tube.
Close the tube and dissolve PEG by mixing vigorously, preferably on an orbital shaker with heating.
Fill the tube with water to 25 ml.
Mix gently by flipping the tube to avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Prepare 10% Tween-20 solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10% Tween-20 solution in a 1.5 ml tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 ul of water to a 1.5 ml tube.
Slowly aspirate 100 ul of Tween-20 with just a tip of the pipette submerged to avoid liquid retention outside of the tip.
Add the Tween-20 to the water.
